name: Conversenses
tagline: AR glasses that give live cues while you talk and an AI evaluation afterwards to improve conversations.
problem: People talk too fast, use fillers or interrupt without noticing.
solution: Smart-glasses HUD shows cues and five indicators that turn from green to red; an LLM judge evaluates the conversation afterwards.
demo_moment: Team-described: speak too quickly and see a 'pause' cue.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Snap AR” among 122 submissions.
Feedback during the conversation, not only after.

lessons: Subtle real-time cues beat reports nobody reads.
